scope: Read-only independent review of exactly the requested CI files. No source research, builds, browser launches, local listeners, full external link scan, or screenshots.
result: One actionable P2 finding; no additional actionable issues identified in reviewed inputs.

findings.title: Reject configurations that disable every performance measurement
findings.description: The configuration is parsed without validation. With paths:[] the script records zero results; with runs:0 it records six results whose metric and score values are undefined. Both cases finish successfully with failures:[] and no Lighthouse calls, because the comparison expressions do not reject missing aggregates.
findings.recommendation: Validate configuration before creating the server or launching Chromium: require a nonempty list of local page paths, a positive integer run count (at least three if the stated three-run policy is intended), finite nonnegative limits for the required metrics, and a finite performance-score threshold between zero and one. Before accepting each page, require the expected sample count and finite aggregate metrics/score. Add bounded failure-case coverage for empty paths, zero runs, invalid thresholds, and missing results.
findings.currentConfiguration: The committed configuration currently contains six paths, three runs, valid LCP/CLS/TBT budgets and score0.9; this finding concerns the gate failing open when its configuration is malformed.

checks.name: Bounded link and exact-commit release unit tests
Workflow YAML and required-job coverage
checks.method: Installed js-yaml parser; push/pull_request triggers; exactly verify, visual, standards, cross-browser, performance, dependencies, links; no continue-on-error bypasses

checks.name: Package lock consistency
checks.details: Direct declarations match lockfile;99 new dependency entries; no existing installed-package version changes; resolved packages use npm registry HTTPS URLs.

checks.name: Performance false-pass reproduction
checks.method: Execute the actual script body with imports and all server/browser/filesystem-write/network dependencies stubbed in memory. No listener, browser, disk mutation, or external request.

checks.name: HTML and artifact coverage
checks.details: The recursive file walker includes every emitted file and rejects unexpected non-files. Nu receives the full dist directory with skip-non-html, retains raw diagnostics, and fails on exit status or reported errors. The reproducibility comparison includes complete paths and hashes, including version.json.

checks.name: Synthetic behavior
checks.details: Browser fixtures restrict traffic to the synthetic loopback origin and mock unhandled API calls. The server stores only synthetic local SQLite records and has no email integration. Performance uses a temporary loopback runtime and blocks external HTTPS; all cleanup is in finally after setup.

limitations: The compression test starts an ephemeral HTTP listener and was not run under the no-ports constraint; its source was reviewed.
Linux CI must establish the authoritative Firefox/WebKit execution result. The known Windows WebKit keyboard behavior was not bypassed or retested.
Role locators and ariaSnapshot establish DOM/ARIA expectations, not a manual VoiceOver platform-navigation result.
A full actionlint executable was unavailable; YAML parsing plus workflow structure and command review were completed.
